releases.name: RED HALLWAYS: Horror
releases.summary:
You wake up in a strange place made up of endless red hallways. The exit is only a few steps away, but it's locked. To escape, you'll need to search the maze, solve puzzles, and uncover the key before it's too late.

You're not alone.

Something is wandering the hallways, and it's hunting you.

releases.name: RED HALLWAY: Horror
releases.summary: For 200 years you've been trapped in Castle Camelot. It's time you finally escape now to find and destroy the people who did this to you!Fire, Ice, or Thunder?Which dragon shall escape from Castle Camelot?!

releases.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival
releases.summary: Fight walkers as Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon and Michonne in a brutal arcade brawler set in the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. Face ruthless enemies like the Saviors and overwhelming walker swarms as you unleash relentless combos, signature weapon attacks, and crushing finishers.

releases.name: The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas
releases.summary:
Every Who down in Who-ville is jingling, singing and celebrating. And guess who can’t wait to join them… the Grinch! Now, with a heart three sizes bigger, and a wish to show the Whos he’s changed, could the Grinch’s prize-winning tree be the perfect way to prove it?

Play as the Grinch and Jumbo-Jump through snowy 3D worlds, collecting ornaments to make your tree sparkle brighter with every step. Overcome platforming challenges, explore every nook and cranny, and use the clever gadgets you find to get through each level. Unleash the Snowball Maker to freeze mischievous adversaries, launch into action with the Rocket Skates, and reach new heights with the Jetpack.

Each level is filled with festive adventures. Hop through the Grinch’s Cave, dodging falling stalactites and zipping down watery chutes. Conquer Mt. Crumpit’s slippery ice and giant rolling snowballs. Find your way through Who-wood’s towering trees and springy mushrooms. Then explore Who-ville, leaping across hovering platforms and sneaking into the Whos’ cozy homes. Use your candy canes to break objects and release dazzling ornaments to decorate the Grinch’s Christmas tree and Who-ville Square.

Adventure solo or team up in local co-op mode. Together with Max, you’ll have fun outsmarting pesky mice, wild forest bats and other curious creatures. Uncover hidden paths and collect every sparkly decoration you can find to make your tree shine.

Make it a merry day in Who-ville, spread Christmas cheer, and create the most spectacular tree the Whos have ever seen!

releases.name: Artis Impact
releases.summary: Artis is a light-hearted JRPG. Story-driven JRPG! Minimalist animations comprising adventure packed with fun & humor!

releases.name: Tristia: Legacy
releases.summary:
"Tristia of the Blue Sea" has been fully renewed with graphics and revived in the latest environment! We will deliver it to everyone under the title of "Tristia: Legacy".

In the simulation part, you can enjoy the super-realistic town development simulation that has been well received, and in the adventure part, you can enjoy a hot story that interweaves comics and seriousness unfolding in Tristia.

Experience the story of the origin and beginning of the long-running Tristia series with graphics that have been completely revised for modern times while retaining the fun of inventing in the workshop.

releases.name: Tristia: Restore
releases.summary:
In order to rebuild the desolate oceanic city Tristia, the genius inventor girl "Nanoca Franca" begins a big strategy to revitalize the city!

"Tristia: Restore" is an action game based on the PC game "Tristia in the Blue Sea" released by Kogado Studio in 2002. 

Requests for the invention and production of items are constantly pouring in at Nanoka's workshop, which has come to revitalize the deserted town.
It's not just work that uses your head, but sometimes you have to run around the workshop from right to left to fulfill requests.

There are clear conditions for each stage. Clear when all the conditions are met before the time limit ends! You can proceed to the next story/stage.

releases.name: Mr. Sleepy Man
releases.summary: Mr. Sleepy Man is up way past his bedtime and out of control! Make a mess of everything you find and turn Bedtime Town against you! This sandbox adventure is filled with comical hijinks, outrageous characters, and platforming action!

releases.name: Homebound Plush
releases.summary:
Unfortunately, the teddy bear was left behind, and now your mission is to help him find his way home. Face a unique boss at the end of every level!

Embark on a charming adventure with a teddy bear who was accidentally forgotten by a young boy during a move and must now set out on a journey to reunite with his owner. Run, jump, and explore vibrant pixel art levels, facing enemies and traveling through a variety of environments, including houses, gardens, and city streets.

Collect special items along the way to aid your adventure.

Each level features its own exciting boss battle.

With precise controls, moderate challenges, and a cozy atmosphere, this is the perfect adventure for fans of classic 16-bit platformers. Test your skills through a fun and heartwarming journey filled with charm for players of all ages.

releases.name: Tap Monster Duel
releases.summary:
An adventure to find the ultimate legendary card hidden in the Wind Forest!

The mysterious 'Wind Forest' where external cards do not work at all.
Start with basic monster cards alongside your guide, 'Kumira', and build your ultimate deck!
Collect and enhance monsters across four elemental attributes (Water, Fire, Wood, Iron) with unique character abilities, and overcome the trials of villains and guardian deities threatening the Wind Forest.

Key Features
Intuitive one-button timing battles played with just a single finger!
Tap the matching elemental icon according to the rotating circular gauge!
Claim the initiative with precise timing and deliver fatal strikes utilizing elemental matchups.

4 Elements and Deep Elemental Matchup Strategy
Clear matchup relationships among the four elements: Water, Fire, Wood, and Iron!
Strategic fun in analyzing enemy attributes to build decks with advantageous element monsters.

releases.name: WordBuzz 4
releases.summary:
Build words, score points, and master the hive.

WordBuzz 4 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you eight letters: seven outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all eight letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the global rankings, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

WordBuzz 4 uses a British English dictionary.

Features
• Play through 5,000 all-new word puzzle levels
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all eight letters
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off
• Skip to the next level after 24 hours
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode

releases.name: Doorway to Nightmares: Terrifying Tales
releases.summary:
Chilling tales await. Uncover fear in the art.

When you finally expose the truth behind the story, can you handle what it reveals?

Some scares hide in plain sight.
Read eerie situations, study the illustration, and solve each mystery like a detective in a horror tale.

How to play is simple:
・Read the question carefully
・Find the matching clue hidden in the illustration
・Tap the spot you think answers the prompt
・With each correct answer, the story’s truth comes into clearer focus

Perfect for fans of horror, mystery games, and quick deduction puzzles.
Step through the doorway, follow the clues, and see what is waiting in the dark.

releases.name: The Master Detective's Eye -Memorize the Scene in 60 Seconds! Case Files from the Streets of 18th-Century London-
releases.summary: Chemin is a puzzle game whose goal is to place numbered pieces in a board in a continuous ordered sequence taking into account the pieces already in the board.The only rule is that a piece must be placed up, down, right or left of the previous one in order to form a continuous sequence to fill the board.Features:4 levels with increasing difficulty100 puzzles (25 puzzles per level)Boards with 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, and 7x7 tiles

releases.name: Jigsaw Puzzle: Fun Shapes
releases.summary:
Discover a fresh twist on classic jigsaw puzzles in Jigsaw Puzzle Fun Shapes! Complete 30 colorful and entertaining levels featuring unique puzzle pieces in all kinds of fun and creative shapes.

Each puzzle offers a charming illustration and a new challenge, making every level feel different. With cute artwork, vibrant colors, and relaxing gameplay, it's a delightful experience for players of all ages.

releases.name: HIRAGANA Word Challenge
releases.summary:
Hiragana practice, made fun!

Ready to build Japanese words one character at a time?

HIRAGANA Word Challenge is a casual quiz game where you use the illustration as a clue and choose the hiragana that completes the word. It’s a fun way to connect pictures, words, and kana while building the basics of Japanese.

How to play is simple:
・Look at the illustration
・Check the word with one missing hiragana
・Choose the right answer from four options
・Read the explanation to learn more

After each question, you can review helpful notes about meaning, usage, related expressions, and bits of Japanese culture connected to the word.

The short, quick questions make it easy to play during a break. Great for beginners, anyone brushing up on hiragana, and families who want to enjoy Japanese language and culture together.

releases.name: Solitaire Companions - Cats
releases.summary:
A classical Solitaire game with a purr-fect twist. Play classic Solitaire in a cozy, cat-filled world.

This game combines timeless Solitaire gameplay with a warm, charming presentation filled with soft colors, cozy scenes, and adorable cats.

Play classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play.

As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include beautiful cat-themed card skins, serene backgrounds inspired by sunny windowsills, cozy living rooms, and blooming gardens, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually.

Before each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer soft pastel tones, playful feline illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing.

With no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, the game offers hours of soothing gameplay and a constantly growing collection of beautiful cards.

releases.name: Math Pals - Monster Mania
releases.summary:
Learn math with friendly monsters and fun challenges.

This game is an educational math game designed for preschool and elementary school children.

Children learn core math skills—counting, addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division—through playful, monster-themed multiple-choice quizzes. Each topic is divided into 20 levels that gradually increase in difficulty, starting with small numbers and visual aids and building up to larger numbers and more advanced tasks.

Every level features a highscore and star rating, giving children,
parents, and teachers a clear overview of progress and confidence in each topic.

Tasks vary constantly: counting monsters, adding dice and fingers, finding missing numbers, combining animals or creatures, and more. Built-in spaced repetition ensures that learned topics return naturally over time, helping children retain knowledge without pressure.
Friendly monsters celebrate success, encourage effort, and make learning math feel fun and rewarding—while mistakes are treated gently as part of the learning journey.

releases.name: Psychopath Mind Quiz: Unmask Their Dark Nature
releases.summary:
Can you pick the “normal” answer? Dark mind teasers await Unmask the hidden choice!

Does your answer seem as ordinary as you think?

Take on a slightly dark psychological quiz built around chilling situations. Study each image, choose from the options, and try to spot the line of thought that feels just a little different from the usual response.

Playing is easy!
・Study the image
・Think about what you would do
・Choose one answer from four options

“Why would someone act like that?”
“What were they thinking in that moment?”
The reveal behind each answer may give you a little shiver.

No complicated steps needed. It is quick to play in short sessions, great for thinking things through on your own or guessing with friends by asking, “Which one would you pick?”

Recommended for anyone who likes:
・Psychology quizzes and mind teasers
・Unexpected answers and tricky questions
・Testing deduction and intuition
・Quick quizzes for spare moments
・A slightly dark theme
